# mimecast_journaling_service (Resource)

Manage a Mimecast Cloud Gateway journaling service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mimecast_journaling_service" "example" {
  description                        = "tf-example-journaling"
  enabled                            = true
  message_format                     = "standard_eml"
  remove_journal_headers             = true
  journal_non_internal_addresses     = true
  journal_unknown_internal_addresses = true
  transfer_protocol                  = "smtp"
  smtp_email_address                 = "journal@example.com"
  smtp_ip_ranges                     = ["192.0.2.0/24"]
  smtp_uses_authentication           = false
  smtp_uses_tls                      = true
  smtp_extended_deduplication        = true
  smtp_inactivity_timeout            = 180
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Description identifying the journaling service.
- `transfer_protocol` (String) Journaling transfer protocol.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the journaling service is enabled.
- `journal_non_internal_addresses` (Boolean) Whether messages without an internal address are archived.
- `journal_unknown_internal_addresses` (Boolean) Whether messages with unknown internal addresses are archived.
- `message_format` (String) Journal message format.
- `pop3_detailed_logging_is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether detailed POP3 troubleshooting logs are enabled.
- `pop3_email_address` (String) POP3 journal mailbox email address.
- `pop3_encryption_is_relaxed` (Boolean) Whether relaxed POP3 certificate validation is enabled.
- `pop3_host` (String) POP3 journal mailbox hostname or IP address.
- `pop3_mailbox` (String) POP3 journal mailbox username.
- `pop3_password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) POP3 journal mailbox password. Write-only; increment pop3_password_wo_version when changing it.
- `pop3_password_wo_version` (Number) Version trigger for pop3_password_wo. Increment this when changing the password.
- `pop3_port` (Number) POP3 journal mailbox TCP port.
- `pop3_uses_pop3s` (Boolean) Whether the journal mailbox is accessed using POP3S.
- `remove_journal_headers` (Boolean) Whether Mimecast removes Microsoft Exchange journal headers.
- `smtp_delivery_wait_attempts` (Number) Number of attempts to match a message before archiving.
- `smtp_email_address` (String) SMTP journaling email address.
- `smtp_extended_deduplication` (Boolean) Whether extended deduplication is enabled.
- `smtp_inactivity_timeout` (Number) Minutes without journal activity before the service enters an error state.
- `smtp_ip_ranges` (List of String) Additional IPv4 CIDR ranges permitted to submit SMTP journal messages.
- `smtp_password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) SMTP journaling password. Write-only; increment smtp_password_wo_version when changing it.
- `smtp_password_wo_version` (Number) Version trigger for smtp_password_wo. Increment this when changing the password.
- `smtp_prefers_clear_text` (Boolean) Whether Active Directory protected journal items prefer clear text.
- `smtp_process_initial_delay` (Number) Minutes to wait before matching a message to the archive.
- `smtp_uses_authentication` (Boolean) Whether SMTP password authentication is required.
- `smtp_uses_tls` (Boolean) Whether SMTP journal traffic uses TLS.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Mimecast journaling service ID.
- `last_received_date_time` (String) Time the last journal message was received.
- `queue_size` (Number) Number of messages in the journaling queue.
- `smtp_hostnames` (List of String) Journal Send Connector hostnames returned by Mimecast.
- `status` (String) Journaling service status.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mimecast_journaling_service.example journaling-service-id
```
